name: Long-Context Attention Benchmark
description: A unified benchmark integrating representative attention kernels and context parallel mechanisms to evaluate efficiency, scalability, and usability of long-context attention methods in transformer-based LLMs. It assesses performance across attention mask patterns, sequence lengths, and distributed scales.
reputation: A recent systems benchmark that is primarily known in the long-context and efficient-attention research community rather than as a broad general-purpose benchmark.
notes: Focuses on benchmarking attention mechanisms for long-context training on up to 96 GPUs; provides reproducible comparisons and practical guidance.
